## Purpose

Owner outcome: "Keep the newest source result current despite out-of-order completion, while retaining the separate pending CSV-format work."
Design strategy: "Use the concrete unresolved question; reuse existing work and keep conditional future work distinct."
This step: "Locate the first violation of the current-result invariant."
- O-CURRENT: "Preserve the newest result."; done when: "Old completion rejected; current completion accepted."

## Deliverable

"Execute one old/new completion contrast and report the actual result."
Assignment support: GUIDED
Method: "Execute one old/new completion contrast and report the actual result."
Required understanding:
- "A completed request may belong to an obsolete source revision."
- "State ownership, request revision and event ordering: Needed to interpret the concrete case and its limits."

Profiles: ["Purpose and uncertainty", "Contracts and causal logic"]

- C-SOURCE [CONSTRAINT/CURRENT] "Preserve current source identity and result attribution."

- R-CURRENT [REQUIREMENT/CURRENT] "An obsolete completion must not overwrite the current result."

## Success criteria

Observable: "Show the current revision, each event and resulting payload."
Negative/contrast case: "Reverse the completion order and preserve current-request success."

## Uncertainty handling
